# netactuate_nke_lb_services (Data Source)

Reads NKE LB Services visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_nke_lb_services" "example" {
  cluster_id = netactuate_nke_cluster.example.cluster_id
}

output "lb_addresses" {
  value = { for s in data.netactuate_nke_lb_services.example.services : "${s.kind}/${s.namespace}/${s.name}" => s.vip }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The NKE cluster ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `services` (List of Object) Managed load-balancer services (Services/Ingresses) reported by the VPC load balancer add-on (netactuate-cloud-lb) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
